definitions.explanation: A vivid, bright shade of red. One of Japan's traditional colors, historically associated with nobility and high rank.

examples.japanese: {緋色|ひいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧。
⟦{紅葉|もみじ}→紅葉：05387_momiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{緋色|ひいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{色|いろ}づいた→色づく：10074_irozuku⟧。

{緋色|ひいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{袴|はかま}→袴：02245_hakama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧まとった⟦{巫女|みこ}→巫女：12408_miko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{境内|けいだい}→境内：12095_keidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いている→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: A shrine maiden wearing scarlet hakama is walking through the shrine grounds.

notes:
A vivid bright red, one of Japan's traditional colors. The character {緋|ひ} specifically refers to this shade of red and is rarely used outside of color descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {緋色|ひいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧: scarlet kimono
- {緋色|ひいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{袴|はかま}→袴：02245_hakama⟧: scarlet hakama (worn by shrine maidens)
- {緋色|ひいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まる→染まる：04254_somaru⟧: to turn scarlet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{茜色|あかねいろ}→茜色：22033_akaneiro⟧: madder red — a warmer, more orange-tinged red
- ⟦{朱色|しゅいろ}→朱色：20098_shuiro⟧: vermilion — a brighter, more orange shade
- ⟦{紅色|べにいろ}→紅色：23780_beniiro⟧: crimson — a deeper, cooler red
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{赤|か}→真っ赤：03734_makka⟧: bright red — everyday word for vivid red

CULTURAL NOTE:
In traditional Japan, {緋色|ひいろ} was associated with high social rank. The scarlet ⟦{袴|はかま}→袴：02245_hakama⟧ worn by ⟦{巫女|みこ}→巫女：12408_miko⟧ (shrine maidens) is one of the most recognizable examples. The color also appears in the Japanese title of Arthur Conan Doyle's "A Study in Scarlet" ({緋色|ひいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧).
